﻿CLIPFARM x KITSCH x NIC VANS CAMPAIGN BRIEF
	

Kitsch makes hair care and hair gifts. Nic from Love Island USA dresses as Santa. He gives Kitsch gifts to his mom and sister.
CPM
$1.50 / 1K
	MAX PER CLIP
$350
	MIN PAYOUT
$1.50
	

⚠ SPECIAL RULE: NO RAW REPOSTS
The footage is short and uncut.
You must edit it. Cut the best parts and tell a story, add unique hooks.
Raw footage with no edits = rejected.
	

READ THIS FIRST — DON'T SKIP
Kitsch must be in EVERY clip.
Show the Kitsch gift or product on screen.
Make Nic look good. Sweet, fun, and kind.
No Kitsch in the clip = no pay.
	

QUICK FACTS
Client
	Kitsch x Nic Vans (Love Island USA)
	Page Type
	Any with 10+ followers
	Content
	Nic dressed as Santa. He gives Kitsch hair gifts to his mom and sister.
	Platforms
	TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
	Tagging
	Instagram and YouTube: @mykitsch 
TikTok: @kitsch 
	Caption
	Your own words. Name Kitsch in some captions.
	Audience
	40%+ Tier 1 Audience (US, UK, Canada, Australia)
	

✔ THE GOAL
Nic is "Saint Nic" this year.
He plays Santa for the women in his life.
Fans love Nic with his mom and sister. Show that.
Make it sweet and funny. Show Kitsch every time.
	

❌ NOT THE POINT — THESE GET REJECTED
* Raw footage with no edits.
* A clip with no Kitsch product.
* Making fun of Nic. Love Island drama.
* ALTERING NICS VOICE / SPEEDING UP HIS VOICE
* REPEAT B-ROLLS AND SOUND EFFECTS
	WHAT TO DO
It is easy. Just follow these steps.
1. Get our clips from the folder below.
2. Make a short video using ONLY the provided footage.
3. Add what is REQUIRED and post.
4. Submit your video on Whop.
5. When your stats load, open a ticket in Whop or Discord for approval.
Not sure how to submit? See the "How To Submit Clips" section.
HOOK IDEAS
Use these ideas. Or make your own.
* "No Way Nic From Love Island Is Handing Out Hair Gifts Dressed As Santa"
* "Saint Nic Is Coming To Town 🎅"
* "Who Is Nic's Last Gift For? 👀"


HOW TO TELL THE STORY
1. Hook first. Grab them in 1–2 seconds.
2. Show Nic as Santa.
3. Show the gift. Kitsch must be clear on screen.
4. End strong. A funny, sweet, or mystery moment.
WHERE TO GET THE CLIPS
Footage folder: DROPBOX LINK
Kitsch products to show:
* Advent Calendar
* Curl Cream
* Set & Flow Headband (grey)
* Sweet & Silky Hair Set
* Holiday gift sets, scrunchies, and more


⚠ Use ONLY clips from our folder.
Clips from anywhere else = rejected.
	RECOMMENDED FOOTAGE
These are the best moments. Build your clip around one.
WHAT
	WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
	Sister's Gift Reveal
	His sister opens Kitsch best sellers and holiday sets.
	The Big Drop for Mom
	Mom gets a huge pile of Kitsch gifts. Very extra.
	The "Saint Nic Tax"
	Nic takes the Curl Cream from his sister's gift. Funny.
	The Cliffhanger
	The last gift is for a "special someone." Keep it a mystery.
	WHERE TO POST
* TikTok
* Instagram Reels
* YouTube Shorts
TAG THE CLIENT (REQUIRED)
TikTok
	@kitsch
	YouTube Shorts
	@mykitsch
	Instagram Reels
	@mykitsch
	YOUR CAPTION (REQUIRED)
Write your own relevant to clip / recap.
Keep it short and clear. English ONLY.
Name Kitsch in some captions. Not every one. Keep it fun, not salesy.


DO NOT TAG NIC OR ANYONE ELSE OR YOU WILL GET REJECTED AND REMOVED FROM THE CAMPAIGN


CAPTION IDEAS — make them your own
* Nic from Love Island played Santa for his mom 🎅
* Saint Nic said his sister made the nice list 🎁
* He really stole the Kitsch Curl Cream 😭
* Mom got the BIG Kitsch drop this year
* Who is the last gift for? 👀
* Saint Nic brought Kitsch for the whole family
	YOUR AUDIENCE (REQUIRED)
At least 40% of your views must come from:
US, UK, Canada, Australia
	HOW TO SUBMIT (REQUIRED)
1. Post your video.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Submit it on Whop.
4. Submit your video demographics when the clip hits min payout.
5. Wait for approval. Then you get paid.
THE RULES
✅ YOU MUST
	❌ YOU WILL NOT GET PAID IF
	Post to: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
	Clips from outside the official link
	Keep your post up at least 30 days
	NSFW, violent, or off-topic videos
	Likes are visible (hidden likes = rejected)
	Spam (same clip, hook, and caption posted again)
	At least 0.50% engagement (1,000 views = 5 likes / shares / comments)
	Paid ads, story boosting, or "boost / promote" tools — no fake views, no bots
	40%+ Tier 1 audience (US, UK, Canada, Australia)
	Bait posting (random viral clips to farm views)
	Submit video demographics
	Stealing / reposting somebody else's content
	One person = one edit. Crosspost it once to each platform. New posts need a new edit, caption, and on-screen text.
	Raw footage with no edits
	Show a Kitsch product in every clip
	No Kitsch product in the clip
	Edit the footage. Cut parts together into a story.
	Mean edits or making fun of Nic
	Make Nic look good
	Naming or guessing who the "special someone" is
	

	Commenting on or DMing Nic or Kitsch
